  "required_fixes": [
    "R2 (remaining) — Validate the complete effective header set for registered-origin requests. crates/desktop-core/src/workbench/admission.rs:393 checks only plan.headers for Host/forwarding overrides, while execute.rs:383 later creates a header from Auth::ApiKey.name. Consequently [auth] kind=\"api-key\", name=\"Host\", secret=\"host-value\" bypasses the new Host rejection at a registered Prisma destination. The non-managed branch at admission.rs:516 also accepts literal method-override headers and conflicting/duplicate Authorization sources; it does not apply the managed branch's ambiguity checks. For example, a catalogued GET with X-HTTP-Method-Override: DELETE is admitted as a read and forwarded unchanged. Actual service handling of override headers was not live-tested; admitting them already violates the conservative method/authority contract. Acceptance: before secret resolution or dispatch, reject Host/forwarding and method overrides supplied through either editor headers or generated auth headers, and reject conflicting/duplicate authentication at registered origins. Preserve one valid manual Authorization source and ordinary unregistered HTTP. Add literal production-interface fixtures for these paths, including generated Host and method-override headers.",
    "R5 — Registered-origin mutation reviews are not bound to the authentication and cookie state actually sent. In crates/desktop-core/src/authority/workbench_domain/send.rs:455, the digest reduces Basic and Bearer auth to other.kind(); it omits Basic username and both kinds' secret references. Changing a literal Basic username or switching the direct Bearer secret reference therefore leaves the digest unchanged. Collection secrets are replaced under the same deterministic record ID (workbench_domain.rs:2316; workbench/profile.rs:51), with no credential revision bound to the review. Cookies are absent from the digest and loaded only at send.rs:1063; execute.rs:782 reads the current mutable jar. A secret replacement, cookie-clearing action or intervening Set-Cookie response can consequently change the credential/account used by an already approved mutation. This violates DESIGN.md's explicit auth, credential-revision and cookie-snapshot bindings. Acceptance: changing Basic username, Basic/Bearer secret reference, a referenced collection secret's revision, or effective cookies after review must require a fresh review and send nothing under the old approval, including changes while native confirmation is held. Bind and recheck these inputs without exposing secret values; transmit the same admitted cookie/auth snapshot rather than reading mutable values later."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [],
  "optional_suggestions": [
    "Retarget the surviving 'tenant redirects are followed' mutation probe to an unregistered loopback destination. Its current same-origin target is independently blocked by the registered-origin redirect guard, so changing Managed => false to true survives the fixture suite. The retained results correctly show 39 of 40 probes killed; this probe does not isolate the managed redirect rule."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Read-only review of scoped production source, tests and retained evidence. No builds/tests were rerun, no application or endpoint was launched, no credentials were accessed, and no implementation files were changed. Findings are source-traced; their proposed negative fixtures have not been executed by this reviewer.",
    "Independently recomputed all four supplied fingerprints and verified 528 source-inventory entries, 273 referenced artifacts, run input/output hashes, executable bindings and predecessor hashes. Retained logs report 340 frontend tests, 136 Rust library tests, 13 HTTP integration tests and 5 focused Send tests passing. Recorded native C15-N01 through N09 pass on executable 2451d2aba4c2e48c2f9a86dc51e341f90352e3126b3deb077de3e62b862abf4b.",
    "Prior R1's credential-independent registration/classification and redirect-entry cases, R3's pending-review and pre-send context checks, and R4's derived-credential header redaction are substantially addressed by source and added production-interface tests. Prior R2's explicit-header/user-info cases are fixed, with the remaining effective-header paths identified above. Newly admitted manual-credential mutation reviews expose R5.",
    "Both prior evidence gaps are closed: the new offline/reconnect fixture preserves uncertainty and proves no automatic resend before explicit Apply/Send; the performance driver now checks the selected URL field through activate-field. Recomputed nearest-rank p95 values are response 1106.83 ms, upload 98.33 ms, save 659.98 ms and responsiveness 41.14 ms; maximum process-tree RSS is 262.6 MiB. All are within registered numeric limits.",
    "Native evidence remains synthetic-loopback fixture evidence with staged collection/save-sheet paths. Production file-sheet interaction, spoken VoiceOver output, installed signed packages and live product qualification are not established here. The 193 catalogue entries, including 81 mutation-method specifications, remain specifications rather than live qualification.",
    "C14 attempt-02 remains a failed 8/10 review accepted under D034, with a valid receipt/hash chain. Existing C13/C14 follow-ups remain P04 obligations and are not reissued in this C15 verdict."
  ],
